source.title: Bugs bugs and even more bugs
source.author: Honeybone-1513872

quote: got 10 diamonds, 40-60 of each colour common gem and got ZERO rare gems
notes: April 19 firsthand account of 1000 copper ore; April 22 follow-up https://eu.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/prospecting-1000-refulgent-copper-ore-zero-rare-gems-updated/616811 states 200 prospects and Proficient Processor. Input quality rank and individual diamond hit count unknown. The same player's two posts are one study, not independent samples. Zero rare gems reported, not assigned to specific gem item IDs.

source.title: Bugs bugs and even more bugs
source.author: Honeybone-1513872

quote: 40-60 of each colour common gem
notes: April 19 player reports 40–60 of each common gem color across 1000 Refulgent Copper Ore; does not provide the exact count for Sanguine Garnet. Output name is the color-to-gem identification from Method's Midnight Jewelcrafting table, not an itemized list in the forum. Follow-up https://eu.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/prospecting-1000-refulgent-copper-ore-zero-rare-gems-updated/616811 confirms 200 casts and Proficient Processor. Ore quality rank unknown; castsWithDrop unknown. Same study as the diamond record.

quote: All gems can be individually crushed for a Duskshrouded Stone
notes: Guide describes the individual-gem crushing path; 'a' stone is one output. The official item name is Dusk-Shrouded Stone. This is a Jewelcrafting processing action, not a vendor trade or a confirmed right-click exchange. Item IDs resolved from guide-linked Wowhead pages. Same guide covers all eight gems.

quote: three of a gem can be crushed to produce Glimmering Gemdust
notes: Guide explicitly states that 3 of the same gem produce between 1 and 3 Glimmering Gemdust, regardless of gem quality or variety. Output quantity varies; getCount is null because no exact fixed quantity or distribution is given. This is Jewelcrafting Crushing, not a vendor/right-click exchange.
